top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The director did not have the required 30 hours of annual training.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The staff files reviewed did not have the required Health and Safety training topic certificates for the last full year of training.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two of the five enrolled children's admission information was not available upon request.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The infants did not have infant feeding instructions available for review.

top_violation_types.title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The on-line CPR recertification training obtain did not include use of a CPR manikin.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers had expired CPR and Fist Aid certification.

top_violation_types.title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The infant daily report is not being shared with the parents.
